messages:
Sophie: heads-up — starting perf bring-up for hollow-12b (chat) today. goal: get baseline throughput/latency for fp16 + int8 and a quick ctx/batch sweep so infra can size pools. planning runs tonight, need prioritization and any blocking test data.
Mike: SG. do we have target ctx lengths? 128/512/1024? 2k later?
Sophie: initial sweep 128,512,1024. if int8 looks stable we add 2048 but not tonight.
Alyssa: tagging bench infra — i'll queue ci windows. prefer we run batch sizes 1,2,4,8 and measure p50/p95 plus token/sec. also include a cold-start set.
bench-bot: queued: hollow-12b fp16 sweep (batches 1,2,4,8 | ctx 128,512,1024) — estimated 2.5h. job id: b-45321-01
bench-bot: queued: hollow-12b int8 quick-smoke (batches 1,2,4 | ctx 128,512) — est 1.2h. job id: b-45321-02
Mike: can we run smaller int8 set first and only escalate if latency/regression < 10%? concerned about memory fragmentation on 4k.
Sophie: yes — int8 quick-smoke first. if p95 increases > 20% vs fp16 or generation quality drops -> rollback to fallback-variant.
Josh: reminder: add warmup script + include our prompt set for evals (safety + regression). also capture KV cache hit metrics.
Alyssa: i'll attach the warmup command and prompt files to the job. example command:
```
bench run --id b-45321-01 --model hollow-12b --precision fp16 --batches 1,2,4,8 --ctx 128,512,1024 --warmup true --prompts=regression_set_v3.json
```
Sophie: perfect. prioritization list from my side:
- high: int8 smoke (stability + p95) -> if OK, full int8 sweep
- med: fp16 ctx/batch heatmap (throughput + p50/p95)
- low: 2048 ctx + long-run throughput
Sophie: when bench-bot finishes post results here and i'll open a perf PR with heatmap + artifacts.
bench-bot: b-45321-01 complete: artifacts uploaded -> s3://redwood-bench/hollow-12b/b-45321-01/ (raw latency CSVs + flamegraphs)
Alyssa: grabbing artifacts now. will run the regression diff suite and post summary.
deploy-bot: note: if int8 p95 > 2x baseline, auto-fallback will route production traffic to hollow-12b-fp16-variant until manual triage.
Mike: thanks — i'll start a short profiling pass on NVSMEM and check cudnn kernels next.
Sophie: thanks team. i'll assemble a checklist in the perf PR (warmup, kvcache, prompt set, quality diffs, rollback gates). ping if anything blocks tonight.:thumbsup:
